About this item

  • 【Powerful Cleaning Capability】Our portable washing machine are so clean that disinfectants can be used to kill pathogens. With our camping washing machine, you can enjoy clean clothes in a short time, thus meeting your busy lifestyle and the need for short laundry.This mini washer machine, underwear washing machine, provide a gentle yet highly effective cleaning experience,It ensures a thorough cleaning without causing any harm to sensitive fabrics.
  • 【Portable & Durable Portable Washing Machine】 The foldable mini washing machine uses TPE and food-grade silicone, which will never rust-eaten, more resistant to aging, yellowing, high temperature and corrosion. Our portable clothes washing machines are a wonderful gift choice for family & friends who love cleanliness, food-healthy and travel frequently.
  • 【Time & Energy Saver Portable Washing Machine】 Small size with low power consumption can save water and electricity. With 3 modes deep cleaning half automatic wash, the portable laundry could save your valuable time (the soft washing is up to 10 minutes and the standard washing is up to 5 minutes each load). With low noise design, no worry to disturb rest and sleep!
  • 【Small Size & Large Capacity Portable Washing Machine】 The mini washing machine (11.8*11.8*12.5 inch) has a large capacity of 11 liters and can wash baby clothes, underwear, diapers, towels, socks, swimsuits, single T-shirts, small toys and other small stuff. The drain basket shakes off the excess water and keeps the clothes damp without dripping water. Simply free your hands and enjoy clean laundry. The portable washer always quiet, neat and clean.
  • 【Energy Conservation】Our portable washing machine are carefully designed to minimize and consume energy, making them an environmentally friendly choice for sustainable living. With our small washing machine, you can reduce water and electricity usage and save utility bills without compromising performance.We've designed this camping washing machine with sustainability in mind. reducing your carbon footprint and making a positive impact on the environment.
  • 【Foldable Portable Washing Machine 13L 】 The mini foldable washing machine can be easily moved and transported to anywhere. You can so easy to travel with as it folds down to practically nothing. Our compact portable washing machine is ideal for travel, camping, dorm, RV, home, apartment, dormitories, business trip, bathroom etc.
  • 【4 Non-slip Foot Pads】The portable washing machine has four waterproof rubber feet on the bottom to prevent the machine from moving during the washing process. The small washing machine has a transparent lid. You can easily see the water condition and washing process at any time during the operation of the mini washing machine.
  • 【No Tools Required】 The Portable Washing Machine 13L for apartments can be used directly without assembly. Just put the clothes in - fill with water - set the time - press the start button - take out. The small laundry machine is easy to operate. Open the bottom plug for easy drainage. Product Description

OMCCHK Portable Washing Machine

tips for daily life

  • Washing clothes separately can avoid cross infection. This mini washing machine is designed specifically for small clothes. It is used to wash clothes that require separate cleaning, such as underwear, socks, baby clothes, diapers, towels, vests, toys. The portable washer can makes your clothes cleaner and hygienic. You can say goodbye to hand washing, exquisitely care for your little laziness.

Hands-free for washing delicate items

The capacity of this bucket washing machine is 13L, which can hold up to 13 lb water + 8 Pcs underwear /12 Pcs socks /5 Pcs baby clothes /6 Pcs clothes /5 Pcs baby clothes. Small load washing machine can save water and electricity, protect the environment.

Touch Electronic Panel

This is a foldable small bucket washer and spin dryer with touch electronic panel, washing with one click. There are three cleaning modes for small washing machine: 10min Standard Washing, 5min Soft Washing, and 3min Semi Dehydration

Press and hold the "Switch" button for 2 seconds to turn the washing machine on or off. Toggle the cleaning mode with a single touch of the "Switch" button.

Hidden Handle

3.5lb lightweight

Easy lift with one hand

Washer & Spin Dryer in 1

separate drain basket

No manual wringing

Flexible Drainage

Easy to release water,

flexible drainage

Portable Foldable Mini

Portable Washer

Our portable washer is compact and lightweight, making it the perfect accessory for small apartments, dormitories, RVs, camping trips. The small washing machine is also foldable, making it easy to store and carry around wherever you go.

    • Mr A N
      5.0 out of 5 stars Very convenient
      Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 28 October 2024
      Amazon Vine Customer Review of Free Product( What's this? )
      This portable washing machine is a highly convenient design which is a great on the go accessory to either a camping/caravan kind of trip or maybe even hotel stays especially if you have kids who make mess out of clothes easily. The convenient desktop sized design allows it to be fully portable and perhaps even complemented by the hidden handle design. The unit itself switches on easily enough and just needs to be filled up with water (it holds up to 11l) and then you put it on for your choice of time based on the mini buttons on the front. There's no assembly or anything required so it works right out the box and assuming you're not doing anything special it only needs around 10 mins to complete a cycle which does hold a surprisingly large amount within it (like 5 baby outfits in 1 cycle for example). This speed of wash and convenience allows you to not be hanging around for hours and worrying about getting a whole washing load dry likewise. It's likewise worth mentioning how quiet this machine is when in operation, you barely know it's there (probably given the lower spin cycle). When you're finished simply open the valve at the bottom and direct the waste water down the drain and you're all done. Very simple usage from start to finish and definitely would recommend.

    • Customer Review
      5.0 out of 5 stars Decent washer for camping or travelling easy to use, to store & does deliver fresher cleaner clothes
      Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 2 October 2024
      Amazon Vine Customer Review of Free Product( What's this? )
      The Portable Washing Machine states is a solution for laundry when camping or perhaps traveling in a campervan when you are in tight living spaces. Due to its portability and compact size, it does work well for these instances.

      The compact washing machine is indeed appealing we liked the purple coloring to the mini washer and it feels well made and has a good look to it. When collapsed it fits into a reasonably small space.

      The machine offers powerful cleaning and effectively disinfects clothing with the use of appropriate detergents. The machine does handle lightly stained clothes or those in need of a quick refresh with its five-minute quick wash mode. While heavily stained and workout gear in the ten-minute deep cleaning mode, didn't quite manage as well but it was certainly not bad.

      There are three washing cycles, all of which do a very decent job considering the drying aspect was less successful but again you need to have a level of expectation based on reality and it's a portable washing machine, and in that sense, it did okay oh also it operates quietly and smoothly which is a plus for sure.

      The construction makes me feel it would stand the test of time it's a neat solution for specific needs, and for somewhat of a temporary measure as some clothes will want to go through a standard washer at some point especially if they are really dirty.

      Overall as a washer for camping or traveling this is great it'll last and won't impact your available space to much and it really does deliver fresher cleaner clothes.
